instruction: A cylindrical hand coffee grinder machined from brushed stainless steel, its body showing fine circumferential grain and a knurled grip band around the middle. A folding crank arm with a walnut-toned knob rises from the domed top, and a threaded collar joins the catch cup below. Subtle satin highlights run down the flutes with no polished glare.
